title: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match w
question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM player p
JOIN player_match pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN ball_by_ball b ON b.match_id = pm.match_id AND b.striker = pm.player_id
JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
    AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
    AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
    AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
WHERE pm.team_id = (CASE WHEN m.team_1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team_2 ELSE m.team_1 END)
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM ball_by_ball b
JOIN batsman_scored s
  ON b.match_id=s.match_id AND b.over_id=s.over_id AND b.ball_id=s.ball_id AND b.innings_no=s.innings_no
JOIN player_match pm
  ON b.match_id=pm.match_id AND b.striker=pm.player_id
JOIN match m
  ON b.match_id=m.match_id
JOIN player p
  ON b.striker=p.player_id
WHERE pm.team_id IN (m.team_1, m.team_2)
  AND pm.team_id <> m.match_winner
GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
HAVING SUM(s.runs_scored) >= 100
